standing_grant: The external mode-0600 grant is operator-owned, revocable, and expires within 90 days. Qualification must verify a private Mattermost channel of type D bound to the exact owner and Hermes bot user IDs, the exact destination, and this installed route's SHA-256. The grant restricts permitted sources and attention-policy versions. The file records qualification evidence; it is not live health evidence and does not enable delivery by itself.
secret_handling: Pinned Hermes config does not expand per-route ${...} values. Keep the secret and Mattermost chat ID in the private auth file, then apply them to the private Hermes route config through its operator-owned patch procedure.
